1) We received a trial credit ${15,000} but need it split across three months (Mar–May) for our accounting team so it flows into separate G/L periods. Can Redwood issue a credit memo that segments the allowance into three line items?

2) Can we extend the trial by 30 days to cover late integration tests? No additional charges expected — just extending the promo window.

I've attached a small usage CSV and the PO for reference. Can your team confirm whether a segmented credit memo is possible and how it will post in ERP?

Hi Elena — copying our finance leads to confirm accounting treatment.

Quick responses:
- Splitting the promotional allowance into three dated line items is something we can do on a credit memo draft. We typically issue a single credit memo with distinct line items and memo lines that your AP team can map to months.
- Trial extension: we can provision an additional 30 days on the trial instance. That’s an ops change and I can authorize once finance signs off on the credit memo structure.

Laura/Marcus — can you confirm G/L mapping and whether Redwood will post a single credit memo (with multiple line items) vs three separate memos? Also confirm the accounting impact (contra revenue vs allowance write-off) so Starlite can close their month ends.

Hi Elena / team,

Thanks for the details and the usage CSV — helpful. Short answer: yes, we can provide a credit memo that includes three dated line items. A few notes on posting and GLA mapping:

- We will issue one consolidated credit memo (CM-2027-1192) that contains three line items dated 3/31, 4/30, and 5/31. This keeps a single document in our billing system while giving your ERP the month-level granularity for matching.
- Accounting treatment: Promo allowance is recorded as contra-revenue at issuance. For your internal records, the three line items should be routed to the promo allowance clearing G/L you provide; if you prefer an offset to deferred revenue instead, confirm the G/L numbers.
- Journal entries: Redwood will create a single journal that debits Promo Allowance (contra-revenue) and credits Accounts Receivable clearing. If Starlite needs three separate journal postings, we can export file-level details for your AP/ERP to split on import.

I'm attaching a draft proforma credit memo and a short mapping guide (see attachment). Marcus/Neha — please review the draft and confirm the final GLA values. Once we have that, Karthik can approve the 30‑day trial extension.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Finance Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
